keys.name: pk_speakers
keys.violationGroupSql: SELECT 1 FROM schubert.speakers GROUP BY id HAVING count(*)>1 OR (id IS NULL)

keys.name: uq_speakers_game_normalized_name
keys.violationGroupSql: SELECT 1 FROM schubert.speakers WHERE game_id IS NOT NULL AND normalized_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY game_id,normalized_name HAVING count(*)>1

keys.name: uq_speakers_id_game

speakers.query: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM schubert.speakers GROUP BY id HAVING count(*)>1 OR (id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM schubert.speakers WHERE game_id IS NOT NULL AND normalized_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY game_id,normalized_name HAVING count(*)>1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM schubert.speakers WHERE id IS NOT NULL AND game_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id,game_id HAVING count(*)>1) violations
